reasons: The number printed on this card, XXXX XXXX 0120, cannot be an Aadhaar number. Every issued number carries a built-in arithmetic pattern, and this one does not follow it.
A blurred or angled photograph can also cause this by misreading a digit. If the card looks genuine, photograph it again flat and in focus before treating this as a forgery.
standard_ref: UIDAI Aadhaar numbering scheme: twelve digits, the last derived from the other eleven by the Verhoeff scheme
